title: Happy Toddler in Swimsuit by Pool, 1950s Backyard B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid mid-20th-century black-and-white snapshot depicting a joyful toddler wearing a striped one-piece swimsuit, leaning eagerly over the edge of a backyard kiddie pool on a sunny day. Sunlight creates soft shadows on the water, highlighting mid-century American suburban family life and summertime childhood leisure.
